notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
When the Goblins enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers three times, adding {C}{C}{C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat.
